 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER Heard on this fifth application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the petitioner for grant of bail.
First and second applications filed by the petitioner was dismissed on merits vide order dated 27.07.2020 & 13.01.2021 passed in M.Cr.C. No.9797/2020 & M.Cr.C. No.38417/2020 respectively.

The third application was dismissed for want of prosecution vide order dated 17.11.2021 passed in M.Cr.C. No.32039/2021 and the fourth application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 14.02.2022 passed in M.Cr.C. No.58419/2021.
The petitioner is in jail since 15.02.2020 in connection with Crime No.10/2020 registered at Police Station-Bakal, District-Katni for offence punishable under Sections 366, 376, 342, 506 of IPC.

sentences.text: Delay in trial is the sole ground which has been pressed by learned counsel for the petitioner to seek bail but, after going through the proceedings which have been narrated by learned counsel, this Court is not inclined to take a different view than the one taken earlier; therefore, the petition is dismissed.

However, as submitted by learned counsel that even after direction of this Court to conclude the trial at the earliest, there is no substantive progress in trial; therefore, the trial Court is again reminded regarding the direction issued by this Court earlier.
With the aforesaid petition stands disposed of.

(VIRENDER SINGH) JUDGE Loretta Praveen Dubey vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103323741/
